piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS AGAIN, ARORA STAYS CLEAR
piece.standfirst: Haaland let the armbands down for a second week running, and Kartik's N.Jackson punt took the week while the top 3 barely budged.
piece.big_picture: 76 managers backed Haaland. He blanked for the second week running, and the faith is starting to look like a habit. Rajat Arora still stretched his lead to 18 over Neol. Arora keeps winning the title race on other people's mistakes.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Swapnil picked the wrong 11 and left 26 points on the bench. That is more than a whole decent week for some managers. Great squad, wrong lineup. The sort of week that makes you check the team sheet twice.
piece.one_to_watch: Prathap holds the last big-prize place and Cherag sits just 2 behind. Cherag is a 2-time champion and has been in that zone before. If Prathap's run of good weeks stalls, the place could flip.

title.title: Rajat's Lead Keeps Growing
title.text: Rajat Arora leads Neol by 18 points, 734 to 716, and has spent 4 weeks on top this run. The lead has changed hands 4 times this season, and Aryan Khamankar is third, 27 points back.
title.next: If Neol or Aryan cannot trim the gap, Rajat's grip on the top spot could tighten.

underdog:4722308.title: Biswadeep's remarkable climb
underdog:4722308.text: Biswadeep is up to 6th of 113, after starting GW1 at 85th and climbing 79 places since. Rank 11 in GW9 to 6 in GW10 shows the momentum is still building.

chase:18991.title: Arshad closes in fast
chase:18991.text: Arshad has cut Adrian's lead from 48 in GW7 to 39, then 24, and now just 2. Adrian is still ahead, but the chase has never been closer.

gold.title: 9th Place Up for Grabs
gold.text: Prathap holds the last top-prize place, just 2 points ahead of Cherag. Cherag has spent 4 of the last 5 weeks inside the zone, while Prathap has spent only 1.
gold.next: If Cherag gains on Prathap this week, the 9th spot could change hands.

champions.title: Champion Chasing Top 10
champions.text: Cherag, a 2-time champion, sits 10th and is the best-placed former winner in the league. Zorawar is 36th, Bhavin 33rd and Kunaal, with 4 titles, 56th.
champions.next: If Cherag stays in the top 10, a former champion could make a real run at the title.

chase:3991082.title: Sukrut Closes to 3
chase:3991082.text: Sukrut trails Yash Bhatia by just 3 points after GW10, down from 60 in GW7. The gap has shrunk every week since, with 37 in GW8 and 18 in GW9.
chase:3991082.next: If Sukrut overtakes Yash next week, the chase ends and the lead changes hands.

slump:10615.title: Maanas Still Searching
slump:10615.text: Maanas has been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. Points have recovered from 42 in GW8 to 55 in GW10, but they are still short of the average.
slump:10615.next: If Maanas's points climb above average, the 6-week slump could finally end.
